info.title: Carbon Copy API
info.description: Programmatic access to Carbon Copy's Polymarket copy-trading platform. Follow traders, manage your portfolio, and automate your prediction market strategy.

ApiKeyAuth.description: API key in the format `cc_<64 hex characters>`. Obtain from the Dashboard under Settings → API Keys.

nextCursor.description: Pass this value as `cursor` in your next request to fetch the following page. `null` when no more pages exist.

hasMore.description: `true` when more pages exist beyond this one.

timestamp.description: Current server time as Unix timestamp (milliseconds).

balance.description: Available USDC balance in the proxy wallet.

positionsValue.description: Current mark-to-market value of all open positions in USDC.

unrealisedPnl.description: Unrealised profit/loss on open positions in USDC.

totalPnLPercent.description: Lifetime P&L as a percentage of invested capital.

winRate.description: Percentage of resolved copy trades that were profitable.

totalTrades.description: Total number of copy trades executed.

activePositions.description: Number of currently open copy-trade positions.

realisedPnl.description: All-time realised profit/loss from closed positions in USDC.

copyTradingEnabled.description: `true` if copy trading is currently active for this trader.

copyPercentage.description: Percentage of each trade to copy.

maxCopyAmount.description: Maximum USDC to deploy per copied trade. `null` means no cap.

totalCopied.description: Total number of trades copied from this trader.

pnl.description: P&L in USDC from trades copied from this trader.

notificationsEnabled.description: Whether notifications are enabled for this trader's activity.

followedAt.description: Unix timestamp (ms) when you started following this trader.

recentTrades.description: The 10 most recent trades by this trader.

winRate.description: Fraction of resolved positions that were profitable (0–1).

followers.description: Number of Carbon Copy users currently copying this trader.

sharpe.description: Sharpe ratio based on P&L history.

realizedPnl.description: Total realised P&L from trades copied from this trader.

totalVolume.description: Total USDC deployed copying this trader.

marketQuestion.example: Will BTC exceed $100k by end of 2025?

pnl.description: Realised P&L in USDC. `0` if not yet realized.

status.description: Current status of this copy trade.

error.message: This key does not have the required scope.

NotFound.description: The requested resource does not exist.

RateLimited.description: Too many requests. Back off and retry.

error.message: Rate limit exceeded. Retry after 30 seconds.

tags.name: Portfolio
tags.description: Portfolio summary, positions, trade history, and P&L.

tags.name: Follow Management
tags.description: Follow, configure, and manage the traders you copy. All routes live under `/portfolio/traders`.

tags.name: Trader Discovery
tags.description: Search and filter traders on the platform. Routes under `/traders`.

tags.name: Orders
tags.description: Inspect orders placed by your copy-trading bot.

tags.name: Markets
tags.description: Market data — prices and token info.

get.description: Returns API health status. No authentication required.
Returns an aggregated summary of your copy-trading portfolio including live wallet balance, open positions value, unrealised P&L, and lifetime stats.
Returns a paginated list of all copy trades. Every item includes a `pnl` field (`0` when not yet realized). Also available at `/api/v1/portfolio/trades`.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Unix ms — filter trades on or after this time.

parameters.name: until
parameters.description: Unix ms — filter trades before this time.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Unix ms — filter trades on or after this time.

parameters.name: until
parameters.description: Unix ms — filter trades before this time.

get.description: Returns time-series portfolio P&L snapshots (captured every 15 minutes) for charting performance over time. Includes realised and unrealised P&L breakdown.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Number of days of history to return.

parameters.name: interval
parameters.description: Aggregation interval — returns the last snapshot per bucket. Use `1h` or `4h` for more granularity.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of currently open copy-trade positions.

post.description: Sell all shares in an open position at the current market price.

positionId.description: Convex document ID of the position.

get.description: Returns realised P&L and volume grouped by each copied trader.
Returns all traders you currently follow, including copy settings and performance stats.

post.description: Start copy-trading a new wallet. Returns `409 Conflict` if already following.

maxCopyAmount.description: Max USDC per trade. Omit for no cap.

error.message: You are already following this trader.

patch.description: Update copy settings for up to 100 followed traders in a single request.

200.description: Results for each update in the batch.

get.description: Returns detailed info for a single followed trader including recent trades.

patch.description: Update copy-trading settings. All fields are optional — only provided fields are changed.

maxCopyAmount.description: Set to `null` to remove the cap.

delete.description: Stop copy-trading this wallet. Existing open positions are **not** automatically closed.

post.description: Temporarily pause copy trading for a specific trader without unfollowing.
Resume copy trading for a previously paused trader.

get.description: Search and filter traders on the platform. Use this to find traders worth following based on performance metrics.
Returns detailed performance analytics for any trader on the platform, including P&L history, drawdown, and Sharpe ratio.
Returns a paginated list of orders placed by your copy-trading bot.
Returns a single order by its document ID.
Fetch the current or historical price for a Polymarket token.

parameters.name: atTime
parameters.description: ISO 8601 timestamp or Unix seconds for historical price. Omit for current price.

get.description: Returns information about the authenticated user's Carbon Copy account.
